scope: provePrepared entry through receipt writing and stage snapshot; excludes native capture, packet decode and final publication
semantics: Process-wide current RSS sampled at 10ms plus entry/exit observations
Observed peak is a lower bound; short-lived peaks can be missed
OS process lifetime high-water mark reported separately, never attributed to current batch
Packet decode, native capture, caller lifetime, GPU residency and allocator ownership are excluded from interval scope
Baseline includes caller allocations still resident when worker enters
Memory report in stage JSON and returned batch metrics; profiling-disabled metrics explicitly null
Sampler joins on success/error; finalization is idempotent
